verbatim_quote.original: اول نگاه کن یه پوشه داریم به اسم پوشه استکس. اگر داره جای استفاده میشه نگهش دار و بهم بگو کجا داره استفاده میشه. اگر جای استفاده نمیشه پاکش کن.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: First, look—we have a folder called the stacks folder. If it is being used somewhere, keep it and tell me where it is used. If it is not used anywhere, delete it.

extracted_decision.summary: Settle the stacks/ folder: keep it only if a live consumer exists and report where; otherwise delete it.
extracted_decision.rationale: Avoid dead configuration; retain only if actually used.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Keeping unused config risks drift; Deleting may break unknown references
